mission: Isolate browser profiles, credentials and network effects behind exact grants.
runtimeTopology: BrowserProfileHost owns generation-bound profile sessions and delegates actual process/network operations to a driver. Servo source/patch identity is pinned separately.
physicalState: Profile/session/page state and outstanding operation receipts are process-local; the selected driver owns isolated profile files. Credentials remain opaque references and are never emitted in observations.
linearization: Profile start requires exact principal/manifest/grant/origin scopes. Page generation advances monotonically. Action dispatch revalidates page, destination, payload, epoch, grant and deadline.
recovery: Indeterminate effects require reconcileOperation before profile close. Stale pages, expired grants, cross-principal profiles and changed operation semantics reject.
security: Page content is untrusted. Network, filesystem, redirect, upload/download, input and credential use are separately granted. Credentials cannot be exported.
capacity: Origins <=128, effect grants <=1024, outstanding operations <=1024, tabs <=16 per deployment profile, observation bytes <=1000000.
terminalObserver: The browser driver observes process/page/action outcomes. Remote business effects require destination-owned reconciliation; page load alone is not success.
externalEvidenceGaps: reproducible Servo binary, isolated process driver and exact patch/build identity
target browser sandbox, DNS/redirect/download/credential policy and remote outcome qualification
